findings.title: OpenRouter Direct Costs Without Entity Links Bypass Budget Enforcement
findings.description: record_cost() accepts workflow_id=None and task_id=None. When both are None, no derivation rollup occurs and no budget enforcement fires. The POST /cost-entries API allows this.
findings.impact: Low — Pi extension always provides entity links. Risk limited to direct API callers. Confirmed by security review as SEC-04 (MEDIUM).
findings.fix: Add cross-field validator to CostEntryCreate requiring at least one of task_id/workflow_id

findings.title: Fragile _extract_session_id Tmux Name Parsing
findings.description: Parses session ID by splitting tmux name on hyphens. If naming convention changes, extraction fails silently and cost collection is skipped.
findings.impact: Low — silent cost data loss only if tmux naming convention changes. Confirmed by security review as SEC-08 (LOW).
findings.fix: Store session_id explicitly in Agent model rather than parsing from tmux name
